content: navigator.clipboard.writeText() requires a secure context (HTTPS/localhost) and in most browsers a transient user-activation gesture (click) to succeed without a permission prompt. Auto-clear must be implemented by the app itself (no native browser API for this) via a setTimeout that calls writeText('') or writeText(overwrite-marker) after the configured duration; this is best-effort only -- it cannot detect or prevent the user manually copying something else in the interim (in which case the 'clear' write would clobber their newer clipboard content, a known password-manager UX tradeoff, mitigated by tracking whether the clipboard still contains what we wrote before clearing it, where the Clipboard read permission allows it).
